**Grant Application: Glocks and Fried Chicken (GAFC) for CalVIP Funding**

**Need:**
Sacramento's communities of color are disproportionately impacted by gun violence, with accidental injuries and deaths often preventable with education. Existing safety programs frequently lack cultural resonance, failing to connect with at-risk youth and families. Glocks and Fried Chicken (GAFC) fills this critical void with culturally competent gun safety education.

**Programs:**
GAFC, partnered with Church of Legacy, delivers innovative programs. Our "Gloxsie 21" cartoon IP engages young audiences with relatable narratives on safe practices. We integrate AI education, empowering participants with critical thinking, data literacy for responsible citizenship, and informed safety decisions. Community workshops provide practical training on firearm handling, storage, conflict resolution, addressing immediate safety needs.

**Outcomes:**
CalVIP funding ($500,000) will enable GAFC to significantly reduce gun-related accidents and fatalities among youth. We project increased gun safety literacy, improved conflict de-escalation skills, and a stronger culture of firearm responsibility within target communities. Participants will gain life-saving knowledge and future-ready skills, fostering empowered individuals and a safer Sacramento.

**Why GAFC is Qualified:**
As a minority-owned social enterprise, GAFC brings authentic understanding and trust to communities. Our distinctive name reflects an unconventional yet effective engagement approach where traditional methods fall short. Coupled with our innovative use of media, technology, and strong community ties through Church of Legacy, GAFC is uniquely positioned to deliver impactful, sustainable gun safety education.
